# Kitchen tools

Personal static site for cooking, shopping, and nutrition. No accounts and no server-side data. Open a page, use the labeled controls, and read the status text after each action.

## Pages

- `/` lists every tool.
- `/dist/main.html` is the recipe app. Search recipes, add servings with the recipe button, remove one serving with the minus button, then use Go Shopping, Nutrition, Plan, Prep, or Start Cooking. A recipe deep link is `/dist/main.html?recipe=<id>`, for example `?recipe=blueprint-smoothie`.
- `/tracker.html` totals selected foods against the FDA limits on the page. Choose a food from the Food list, change quantity with the plus and minus buttons, then press Update Nutrition. The other tab, Add Custom Food (`#custom`), checks a food and shows JSON to paste into the page source. `#tracker` opens the tracker tab.
- `/waterIntake.html` turns liters and clean bottles into gallons using the amounts in the chart on the page. Submit Calculate gallons. The result is in the status line. `?liters=` and `?bottles=` refill the form.
- `/groceryList.html` is a checklist. Each row has a Purchased checkbox. The date at the top is seven days ahead.
- `/expirationCalculator.html` adds each item's days to expire onto today. Mark used with the checkbox.
- `/meatTemp.html` and `/cordSlicer.html` are reference charts.
- `/frozenFood.html` and `/eatThis.html` are notes. Eat This rows have a Tried checkbox.

## WebMCP tools

These exist only in browsers that implement `document.modelContext`. Other browsers ignore them. A bad call returns `{ "error": "..." }`.

### Every page

- `list-pages` lists the tool pages and their addresses.
- `open-page` opens one of those pages.

### Recipe app (`/dist/main.html`)

- `search-recipes` finds recipes by name.
- `list-recipes` lists the visible recipes.
- `list-categories` lists recipe groups.
- `get-recipe` reads one recipe's title, servings, ingredients, steps, times, and notes.
- `list-selected-recipes` reads the current servings.
- `add-recipe-serving` adds one serving.
- `remove-recipe-serving` removes one serving.
- `list-bundles` lists one-tap bundles.
- `add-bundle` adds a bundle to the selection.
- `open-recipe-screen` shows select, shopping, cooking, nutrition, add-ingredient, prep, or plan.
- `get-shopping-list` reads the combined list, scaled by servings.
- `reset-selection` clears the selection and timers, the same as Start Over.
- `read-cooking-status` reads each cooking step's state.
- `advance-cooking-step` taps the next ready step once.
- `start-cooking-timer` starts one timer.
- `skip-cooking-timer` skips a running timer.
- `answer-cooking-gate` answers yes or no on a check step.
- `stop-alarm` stops one ringing alarm, or all of them.
- `read-day-plan` reads the saved day plan.
- `list-prep-steps` reads prep-ahead steps for the selection.

### Other tools

- `list-kitchen-tools` lists the links on the home page.
- `calculate-gallons` converts liters and clean bottles. `read-water-chart` reads the chart and the current result.
- `list-groceries` reads the grocery list. `set-grocery-purchased` checks one row.
- `list-expiration-dates` reads expiration dates. `set-item-used` checks one item.
- `list-eating-alternatives` reads the eat-this table. `set-alternative-tried` checks one food.
- `list-tracker-foods` lists tracker foods. `set-tracker-quantity` sets a quantity and updates the table. `read-tracker-totals` reads that table. `build-custom-food` builds custom-food JSON.
- `read-meat-temperatures`, `read-slice-amounts`, and `read-freezer-notes` read those reference pages.

## Run locally

```
npm ci
npm run build
npm start
```

Open http://localhost:3000/ . The recipe app is http://localhost:3000/dist/main.html . `npm test` runs the checks. `npm run dev` starts Vite.
